annotations.title: Send the page of my day

description: Send the reader's page of the day (today's tasks, what they're waiting on and what comes back later, on the planner template they chose) to their e-reader now. On a reMarkable, ticks made on it come back to the list.

device.description: Optional: remarkable, kindle, or cloud:dropbox / cloud:gdrive / cloud:onedrive.
